note: The keyframes of the figure's animations as data (docs/14, docs/32). A swing style is { fps, activeFrame, frames: [{ pitch, out, lean, bob, offPitch, offOut, wrist }] } (wrist: degrees the held thing is cocked up from the forearm, so a blade stays level as the arm drops); the walk is { frames: [{ stride, lift, arms, bob, lean, headD }] } with a pair per leg and arm [left, right], bob positive down; present is one pose { pitch, out, headD } for the main arm held out (docs/32 item 1); thrust is the halberd's other attack, attack_alt (item 2); the bow's draw bends the string hand's elbow back to the chin by full draw (offBend; Michael, 2026-10-15, #5); bow_rest is the bow's held pose in the idle and the walk (an item's held.pose names a pose here; with offPitch it holds the off arm too), both hands low in front, the other at the string (Michael, 2026-10-14). The elbow (2026-10-15): bend and offBend on a frame or a held pose, bends [left, right] on a walk frame, degrees the forearm turns from the upper arm forward and up; 0 or absent is straight. Edit and press Reload poses in tools/layers.html, or __game.figure.setPoses(json); __game.setLook({}) from the console.
